note: Design record. No schema, migration, route, cron, binding or code exists for it.

read_models.name: Latest value by series
read_models.query: current row for (series_id) with greatest period_start

read_models.name: Release comparison
read_models.query: versions of release A vs release B for a bounded series list

read_models.name: Source provenance
read_models.query: version → release → run → artifact by primary keys

read_models.name: Türkiye-only (subject geography)
read_models.query: series where geo_id in Türkiye subtree (ISO3:TUR + TUIK_IBBS/NUTS children) then current rows
read_models.avoids: join to source area; Türkiye-source ≠ Türkiye-subject

read_models.name: Global comparison
read_models.query: series by (concept_id, geo list) then current rows for one period
read_models.bounds: geo list ≤ 50, one period or short range

read_models.name: Indicator + country + time
read_models.query: series by (dataset/indicator, geo) then period range

read_models.name: Data-quality flags
read_models.query: versions/current rows with quality_state<>'VALID' for a source

read_models.name: Recent material revisions
read_models.query: versions with revision_class<>'NEW_RELEASE' ordered by created_at, joined by version PK to the current projection

read_models.name: Source health
read_models.query: runtime policy + latest run + checkpoints per source (precomputed summary columns)

read_models.name: Same-concept cross-source view
read_models.query: series with the same concept_id and mapping state EXACT/COMPATIBLE for one geo+period, with lineage independence flag
read_models.bounds: one concept × one geo × one period

rule: no routine whole-table analytics; every query names its bound
